name: io.github.tonyyang0504/zalo-messaging-mcp
description: Zalo (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documented endpoin

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: ID of your Zalo app (developers.zalo.me > app > Thông tin ứng dụng).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The app's secret key (Khóa bí mật của ứng dụng); sent only as the secret_key header of the token request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OA refresh_token from the OA authorisation (POST https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with grant_type=authorization_code). Valid 3 months and single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set). Access tokens last 25 h.
